mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,a.granularity,a.plan_type,a.system_code,sys.name AS system_name,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.plan_summary,f.content_type,f.file_size,m.attachment_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_content_attachment ca WHERE ca.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ca.business_type='PLAN' AND ca.business_id=a.id AND ca.deleted=0) AS attachment_count,a.owner_id,a.created_by,a.created_at,a.updated_by,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_plan a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type='PLAN' AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN att_file f ON f.id=m.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.project_id=a.project_id AND c.system_code=a.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem sys ON sys.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND sys.code=c.system_code AND sys.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND a.deleted=#{p.deleted} AND a.granularity=#{p.granularity} AND a.plan_type=#{p.planType} AND a.system_code=#{p.systemCode} AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.doc_code ASC,a.id ASCa.doc_code ASC,a.id ASC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1
SELECT id,tenant_id,project_id,granularity,plan_type,system_code,doc_code,doc_name,plan_summary,owner_id FROM dm_plan WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_plan updated_by=#{p.actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,granularity=#{p.granularity},plan_type=#{p.planType},system_code=#{p.systemCode},doc_name=#{p.docName},plan_summary=#{p.planSummary} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_plan SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_plan SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_plan WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_plan WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND project_id=#{p.projectId} AND granularity=#{p.granularity} AND plan_type=#{p.planType} AND system_code=#{p.systemCode} AND id <> #{p.excludeId}
SELECT attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND business_type='PLAN' AND business_id=#{id} AND deleted=0

SELECT m.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment m JOIN dm_plan a ON a.id=m.business_id AND a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.business_type='PLAN' AND m.business_id=#{id} AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT project_id FROM dm_plan WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
